evidence: Reviewed all 23 criteria (2 gates, 15 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual) for browser-observable outcome, durable evidence and distinctive probes. STRENGTHS: nearly every functional/polish criterion names concrete observable outcomes with explicit positive controls, independent-context readbacks (Mei/Aud), captured-request replays with recorded HTTP status (functional prompt.md:25), suffixed probes (prompt.md:21; 'plain' and 'Call back on Fri' absent from seed and solution), measured readings (document.activeElement, scroll offset within 2 px, getBoundingClientRect().top), and a real restart_app that re-reads many recorded records (hro_intake_restart, functional judge.toml:31; restart_mcp.py single-use tool). Colderwater lessons 7/14 (timing void/repeat) are defined in functional prompt.md:29 and polish prompt.md:80 (t0 only after the trigger succeeds, void definition, at most two repeats, negatives watched for the full window, met=false never repeated); lesson 8 modifier-hold in app_context.md:75-77; lesson 9 report-every-step in prompt.md:31-33; lesson 13 local addresses only; lesson 15 multi-record restart re-read; the scored suite runs with --max-concurrent-agent 1 (test.sh:207) so seeded-state readings are not raced. Gates are concrete (wrong-password refusal plus successful sign-in; UI add, reload and independent Observer readback). Visual rows are Likert craft judgments with anchors, the template convention (skill known false positive), not a functional 'looks right' defect. DEFECT (probe can leave no server trace): tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:103 hro_manager_roles Bar: "Bill's move and note on J1 are not offered or are refused with nothing changed; Ingrid's move is the control." The steps only say "As Bill Okafor try a move on a J1 card and a note on a J1 card" with no required replay; prompt.md:25 only PERMITS replay for an unoffered 'try' step. The golden hides both controls from a non-owning manager (board.js:137 mayNote requires job.manager_id === user.id; board.js:153-154 returns no move targets when job.manager_id !== user.id), so the expected judge path is 'not offered' and the Bar is satisfied by an on-screen absence, which is not durable evidence of 'A hiring manager works only on jobs where they are the hiring manager' (hireops_rules.md:71) or of server-side trust (hireops_rules.md:11-12). No other criterion server-tests a hiring manager moving or noting on another manager's job (hro_readonly_roles covers Observer/candidate/anonymous only; hro_messaging's Ingrid replay covers conversation read/send only). It also conflicts with the prompt's own rule (prompt.md:25) 'Whether a refused action is offered at all is the app's choice; what is graded is that the server refuses it', giving the judge two targets. SAME PATTERN, lower confidence: in hro_manager_roles Ingrid's Applied->Screen, Screen->Interview, Interview->Screen, Screen-card rejection, Applied re-order and Screen-rejection reopen are refused '(UI or replay)'; the golden does not offer these either (board.js:153-155), so a 'UI' refusal can again be satisfied by absence, though 'Rafael's identical requests are the control' hints at replay. hro_moves (judge.toml:40) skip legs and hro_reject_reopen (judge.toml:49) wrong-stage reopen legs rely only on the general prompt rule; for a stage-less reopen the 'inexpressible target' rule in prompt.md:25 legitimately covers it. MINOR NOTES (not blocking): hro_long_thread (judge.toml:139) says 'does not move his place' without a measurement or tolerance, unlike the polish rows; hro_pol_earlier_place (polish judge.toml:43) uses 'within a few pixels'. hro_undo step 5 'as Mei Lin re-order Y within its stage' does not fix the direction; moving Y to the bottom of Screen would shift A2's index, though a one-place move (the natural reading) does not. No configured judge run, Oracle or model score exists (raw-evidence-index scope says so); the golden scripted observations (workspace.json) are server/browser checks, not evidence of how the judge resolves the Bill leg.
counterexample: A submission whose server accepts moves and note writes from any hiring_manager on any job (no manager ownership check) but whose UI, like the golden, hides move buttons and the note box when the job's manager is not the signed-in user. Bill opens J1, sees no move or note controls, the judge records 'not offered', and the Bar 'not offered or are refused with nothing changed' is met, so hro_manager_roles (weight 4) can pass although a request replayed in Bill's session would move Ingrid's candidate. Conversely a judge following prompt.md:25 replays and fails it, so two readings of the same criterion score the same app differently.
suggested_fix: In hro_manager_roles require replaying Rafael's observed move and note requests (fresh legal values) in Bill's session, and Ingrid's out-of-scope stage/re-order/reopen requests in hers, grading the server refusal (403, nothing changed) with Rafael's identical requests and Ingrid's own move as controls; drop 'not offered' as a sufficient pass.
